fullContentHtml:
PFRDA Assistant Manager Phase-I Result 2026 – Full Details

Pension Fund Regulatory & Development Authority (PFRDA) has released the Phase-I Result for the post of Officer Grade A Assistant Manager. This recruitment has been issued for 30 posts. The online application process for PFRDA Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 were accepted 03 September 2026, to 24 September 2026. The Phase-I Exam was conducted on 15 October 2026. Candidates must download their PFRDA Assistant Manager Phase-I Result 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 September 2026
  • Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Phase-I Exam Date : 15 October 2026
  • Phase-II Exam Date : 20 November 2026
  • Phase-I Result : 05 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Phase-I Result
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is PFRDA Assistant Manager Phase-I Result 2026?

PFRDA Assistant Manager Phase-I Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
